description: Drop items on the ground. Provide `slot` to toss that exact inventory slot's whole stack, or `item` (+ optional `count`) to toss by item type (omitting count tosses the whole stack).

count.description: How many to toss; omit to toss the whole stack

item.description: Item name/id to toss (ignored if `slot` is given)

slot.description: Inventory slot index to toss its whole stack from

name: toss_item
